reason: A web interface plugin that adds a session-header branch panel for viewing local Git branches and switching the workspace branch through Git checkout.

summaries.zh: 在会话头部提供 Git 分支状态展示、分支列表和直接切换工作区分支的界面面板。
summaries.en: Adds a session-header Git branch panel for viewing local branches and switching the workspace branch directly from the web interface.

capabilities: Displays the current Git branch for the session workspace
Executes Git checkout to switch branches
Refreshes branch information automatically and manually
Shows checkout errors in the interface
